environment.privacy: Synthetic source only; no customer material or ambient context.
environment.invocation: Compare ordinary requests with explicit Tegy requests and verify the host permission prompt.
environment.validation: Run native plugin evals for routing with fixed MCP fixtures; verify OAuth, paid work, result delivery and recovery separately in the real host.

cases.name: Ordinary executive update stays in Claude
cases.prompt: Turn these notes into a short executive update: launch moved to 18 September; migration is complete; support capacity is unresolved; Maya owns the decision by Friday.
cases.expected_behavior: No Tegy skill, tool, runner, or external request.

cases.name: Ordinary business question stays in Claude
cases.prompt: Should we buy a regional delivery fleet this year? Ask me the most useful question first.
cases.expected_behavior: Answer or ask locally, without a Tegy skill or hosted call.

cases.name: Explicit Tegy Brief uses selected source
cases.prompt: Use Tegy Brief for this. Source text: The warehouse pilot passed on 12 October. Maya will decide on expansion Friday. Audience: leadership. Format: two sentences.
cases.expected_behavior: Select Brief and send only the supplied fields through the host permission flow; one hosted call, no retry.

cases.name: Independent external review selects Review
cases.prompt: Please get an independent external review of this decision. Original brief: Decide whether to expand a warehouse pilot next week while keeping missed deliveries below 3 percent. Candidate: Expand to one more warehouse for two weeks, with Maya checking missed deliveries daily and stopping the expansion if they exceed 3 percent. Evidence: The first warehouse had 2.5 percent missed deliveries during a two-week pilot. Unknowns: The second warehouse has not been tested; this is an explicitly accepted uncertainty. Criteria: Check the decision against the supplied evidence and stopping condition.
cases.expected_behavior: Select Review and make one hosted Review call through the host permission flow; no additional paid operation.

cases.name: Explicit Tegy Solve waits for consent
cases.prompt: Use Tegy Solve. We have decided to restore the old routing rule rather than buy trucks: a two-week test cut missed pickups to 2.5 percent within our 3 percent target, with margin 7.4 percent above our 7 percent floor. We accept the limited test duration. The pilot ran at peak volume, and the old rule was replaced by mistake. Use this as the final candidate; I accept all remaining uncertainty and do not need further investigation. Finish the recommendation.
cases.expected_behavior: Select Solve and prepare or clarify the packet; no hosted call before the user agrees.

cases.name: Cowork unrelated task sends nothing
cases.prompt: Write a friendly one-sentence birthday greeting.
cases.expected_behavior: No Tegy call and no end-of-turn hook.

cases.name: Cowork completed result needs user action
cases.prompt: Use Tegy Brief with this source: The warehouse pilot passed on 12 October. Maya will decide on expansion Friday.
cases.expected_behavior: One accepted request; explain the result card and Discuss result; no polling, receiver calls, automatic continuation, or invented completed brief.

cases.name: Recover an interrupted request
cases.prompt: Retry the exact request I supplied earlier with the same packet and key.
cases.expected_behavior: Only the supplied identical packet/key may reattach; a changed packet must not be retried under that key.
